'''''Cichorium endivia''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] belonging to the genus ''[[Cichorium]]''. It is widely cultivated as one of the species of similar bitter-leafed vegetables known as [[endive]] and escarole.<ref>{{citation |url=https://npgsweb.ars-grin.gov/gringlobal/taxonomydetail.aspx?id=10542 |title=USDA GRIN Taxonomy |accessdate=17 May 2016}}</ref>

There is considerable confusion between the species and [[Chicory|''C. intybus'']] (common chicory).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.innvista.com/health/foods/vegetables/chicory-and-endive/ |title=Chicory and Endive |date=2013-07-31 |accessdate=2026-02-21|website=Innvista|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150729001712/http://www.innvista.com/health/foods/vegetables/chicory-and-endive/|archive-date=2015-07-29}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date= |title=Endive | Archives | Aggie Horticulture |url=http://plantanswers.tamu.edu/vegetables/endive.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090309101929/http://plantanswers.tamu.edu/vegetables/endive.html |archive-date=2009-03-09 |accessdate=2013-08-18 |publisher=[[Texas A&M University]]}}</ref>
